notes.title: Patch 1.01 - Mouse Bug Fixed
notes.content:
Hello!

A new patch has been released that addresses an issue affecting players using mouse. This bug caused the pause menu to overlay on top of the game when playing - this has now been fixed!

Once updated, you should read v1.01 in the lower right corner of the main menu to verify that you have the latest version.

We apologize for the issue and hope you enjoy your time playing.

Thank you!
